report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Priya Nair | Age: 37
Body Temperature at Scene: 25.5°C | Ambient Temperature: 25.5°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 9.6 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  2. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  3. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Ethanol, GHB, Opiates

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
